provenance.adaptation: Editorial rules 1, 3-9, 11, 12, 17 and 19. Factual accuracy overrides style. Benchmark and concealment instructions excluded.

review_rules: Write a quick casual comment about what you notice in the photo, not a catalog description. First person is optional. No required opening: a reaction, fragment or visible detail can work; do not default to The [detail] is/looks or any other repeated frame.
Use everyday words, contractions and short fragments; a fragment can be the whole review. Lowercase starts, loose punctuation and minor spelling or grammar slips are fine; do not force mistakes.
One modest opinion is enough. No exclamation marks or excited interjections, even if the style reference uses them; no stacked adjectives, benefit lists or closing recommendations.
No em dashes, slogans, forced slang, sales language or superlatives such as perfect for, must-have, highly recommend or game changer.
Do not invent purchases, delivery, repeat orders, compliments, personal use, comfort, fit, fabric quality, performance or defects, and do not assume a gender or relationship from a name.
